title: FindSoftware — a register of software to build websites with
excerpt: CMSs, frameworks and static site generators in every language, recorded field by field with a source for every answer. No scores, rankings or affiliate links.
content_html:
A directory of software to build websites and web apps.

  • acme.sh

    ACME protocol client written in POSIX shell that issues, installs and renews TLS certificates from ACME certificate authorities.

  • Active Record

    Object-relational mapping library for Ruby that maps classes to database tables, distributed as part of Rails.

  • Activepieces

    Workflow automation platform with a self-hostable server and an embeddable builder that a SaaS product can place inside its own app.

  • Adminer

    Web-based database management tool distributed as a single PHP file.

  • aiohttp

    Asynchronous HTTP client and server library for Python, built on asyncio, with a web server and a client session API.

  • Ajv

    JSON Schema and JSON Type Definition validator for Node.js and browsers that compiles schemas into validation functions.

  • Alinea

    Git-based headless CMS for Next.js that stores every entry as a JSON file in the project repository.

  • Angular

    TypeScript-based web application framework with client-side, server-side and prerendered rendering.

  • Ant Design

    Enterprise-class UI design language and React component library.

  • Apache APISIX

    Open-source API gateway for routing, securing and managing traffic to APIs, microservices and LLM providers, built on NGINX and etcd.

  • Apache ECharts

    JavaScript library for interactive charts and data visualization that runs in the browser.

  • Apache OFBiz

    Java suite of enterprise business applications for ERP, CRM and e-commerce, built on an entity engine, a service engine and a widget-based UI.

  • Apache ShenYu

    Java-native API gateway for HTTP, Dubbo, gRPC and WebSocket services, with plugins for authentication, traffic control and observability.

  • Apache SkyWalking

    Application performance monitoring system for distributed systems, microservices and container-based architectures.

  • Apache Tomcat

    Java servlet and JSP container, an open source implementation of the Jakarta Servlet, Pages, Expression Language, WebSocket, Annotations and Authentication specifications.

  • ApexCharts

    JavaScript charting library that draws interactive charts with SVG for websites and web apps.

  • Apollo Client

    GraphQL client library for JavaScript that fetches, caches and modifies remote and local application data.

  • Appsmith

    Open source low-code platform for building internal tools, admin panels and dashboards.

  • Appwrite

    Open-source backend platform with authentication, databases, storage, functions and messaging, available as Appwrite Cloud or self-hosted with Docker.

  • ArangoDB

    Multi-model database for documents, graphs and key-value data, queried with the AQL query language.

  • Ariakit

    Open-source React library of unstyled, accessible UI primitives and components for building web apps and design systems.

  • asdf

    Command-line version manager for language runtimes and developer tools, configured per project in a .tool-versions file.

  • ASP.NET Core

    Cross-platform, open-source framework for building web apps and services with .NET and C#.

  • assistant-ui

    Open-source TypeScript and React library of components for building AI chat interfaces.

  • Astro

    Web framework for content-driven websites that prerenders pages to static HTML and can render routes on demand.

  • Astryx

    Open source React design system built on StyleX, with themes and a command-line tool.

  • Atomic Server

    Self-hostable server for storage, search, sharing and sync of Atomic Data, with a web app and a RESTful API.

  • Authelia

    Open-source authentication and authorization server and portal that adds multi-factor authentication and single sign-on in front of web applications.

  • authentik

    Self-hosted, open source identity provider with OIDC, SAML, LDAP and proxy authentication.

  • AutoAnimate

    Zero-config, drop-in animation utility that adds transitions to a web app when elements are added, removed or moved.

  • Autoprefixer

    PostCSS plugin that parses CSS and adds vendor prefixes to rules, using browser support data from Can I Use.

  • Axios

    Promise-based HTTP client for the browser and Node.js.

B

  • Babel

    JavaScript compiler that rewrites next-generation JavaScript into code that runs in the browsers and runtimes a project targets.

  • Base UI

    Unstyled React component library for building accessible user interfaces.

  • Better Auth

    Framework-agnostic authentication and authorization framework for TypeScript.

  • Biome

    Toolchain for web projects with a formatter and a linter, usable from the command line and through a language server.

  • Bits UI

    Headless, unstyled Svelte component primitives for building accessible component libraries.

  • Blazor

    Web UI framework for building interactive web apps with C# and Razor components, shipped as part of ASP.NET Core.

  • BlockNote

    Block-based rich text editor for React applications.

  • Bokeh

    Python library for interactive plots and data applications that render in web browsers.

  • Bootstrap

    HTML, CSS and JavaScript toolkit for developing responsive, mobile-first projects on the web.

  • Bun

    Fast all-in-one JavaScript and TypeScript runtime that also ships a package manager, test runner and bundler as one executable.

C

  • c15t

    Open-source consent manager that renders cookie banners, a preferences dialog and consent-gated scripts for JavaScript frameworks.

  • Camaleon CMS

    Content management system for Ruby on Rails, distributed as a gem and run inside a Rails application.

  • Carbon Components Svelte

    Svelte component library implementing IBM's open source Carbon Design System.

  • cert-manager

    Kubernetes controller that issues and renews X.509 TLS certificates for workloads in a Kubernetes or OpenShift cluster.

  • Chai

    Assertion library for Node.js and the browser that pairs with any JavaScript test framework.

  • Chart.js

    JavaScript charting library that draws charts on an HTML5 canvas.

  • Chartist

    JavaScript library that draws responsive charts as SVG, styled with CSS.

  • ClickHouse

    Column-oriented SQL database management system for analytical queries, available as open-source server software and as a cloud service.

  • CockroachDB

    Distributed SQL database that runs as a cluster of nodes and keeps its data replicated across them.

  • Companion

    Open source Node.js server that handles OAuth and streams files from remote sources such as Google Drive and Dropbox into uploads made with Uppy.

  • Compiled

    Compile-time CSS-in-JS library for React that writes its styles out as atomic CSS.

  • Connect for ECMAScript

    TypeScript implementation of Connect, a family of libraries for building type-safe APIs from Protocol Buffers schemas.

  • Convex

    Open-source reactive database and backend for web apps, with server functions written in TypeScript and a cloud platform run by the maker.

  • CookieConsent

    Vanilla JavaScript consent management library that shows a cookie banner and blocks scripts until visitors consent.

  • Coolify

    Open-source, self-hostable platform that deploys applications, databases and services to Docker containers on the user's own servers.

  • Countly Lite

    Self-hosted analytics and engagement server that collects data from web, mobile and desktop applications and shows it in dashboards.

  • cssnano

    Modular CSS minifier, built on the PostCSS ecosystem, that compresses stylesheets with a set of optimizations and presets.

  • cva

    A TypeScript library for building type-safe, variant-driven class names with Tailwind CSS or any other styling approach.

  • Cypress

    End-to-end and component testing framework that runs tests in a real browser.

D

  • D3

    JavaScript library for bespoke data visualization that runs in the browser.

  • date-fns

    JavaScript library of functions for manipulating dates in browsers and on Node.js.

  • Day.js

    JavaScript library that parses, validates, manipulates and displays dates and times, with a largely Moment.js-compatible API.

  • DBeaver

    Desktop database management tool and SQL client for many SQL and NoSQL databases, with a free community edition.

  • Devise

    Authentication solution for Rails based on Warden, with modules for sign-in, registration, confirmation, password recovery and account locking.

  • Diesel

    Safe, extensible ORM and query builder for Rust.

  • Dioxus

    Rust framework for building fullstack web, desktop and mobile apps from one codebase.

  • Django

    Python web framework with an ORM, URL routing, templating, forms and an automatic admin interface.

  • Django REST framework

    Toolkit for building Web APIs on Django, with serialization, views, authentication and permissions.

  • dnd kit

    Drag and drop toolkit for the web, with a framework-agnostic core and adapters for React, Vue, Svelte and Solid.

  • Doctrine DBAL

    PHP database abstraction layer with an object-oriented API for queries and for schema introspection and management.

  • Doctrine ORM

    PHP object-relational mapper that provides transparent persistence for PHP objects.

  • Dokku

    Self-hosted platform as a service that runs on a single Linux server and deploys web apps pushed to it with git.

  • DOMPurify

    DOM-based XSS sanitizer that cleans HTML, MathML and SVG markup in the browser or on Node.js.

  • dotCMS

    Java content management system with an admin console, REST and GraphQL APIs and multi-site management, distributed as a Docker image and as a managed cloud service.

  • Driver.js

    JavaScript library for product tours, element highlights and feature hints on web pages.

  • Drizzle ORM

    TypeScript ORM that maps SQL databases to typed schemas and queries, with a companion migration tool, Drizzle Kit.

  • DuckDB

    Analytical SQL database that runs in-process inside Python, Node.js and other applications, with a WebAssembly build for browsers.

E

  • e107

    Open-source PHP content management system for websites, blogs and intranets, with a plugin and theme system.

  • Easy CMS

    Embedded headless CMS that runs inside a Nuxt or Next.js app, with a typed local API, a REST API and an admin at /admin.

  • Echo

    Go web framework built on the standard net/http package, with a radix-tree router, request binding, middleware and centralized error handling.

  • Effect

    TypeScript library for building production-grade applications, with typed errors, dependency injection, concurrency, scheduling and schema validation.

  • Elysia

    TypeScript web framework for building backend servers, optimized for Bun and also runnable on Node.js.

  • Embla Carousel

    JavaScript carousel library with fluid motion, swipe gestures and a plugin system, usable with React, Vue, Svelte, Solid or plain JavaScript.

  • EmDash

    Full-stack TypeScript CMS built on Astro, with an admin panel, a REST API and a plugin system, that runs on Cloudflare or a Node.js server.

  • Emotion

    CSS-in-JS library for writing styles with JavaScript, with packages for React and for other frameworks.

  • Envoy

    Open source edge and service proxy for cloud-native applications.

  • es-toolkit

    JavaScript utility library of general-purpose functions for arrays, objects, promises and types, with a compatibility layer for Lodash.

  • esbuild

    JavaScript and TypeScript bundler and minifier, shipped as a native binary with a JavaScript API.

  • ESLint

    Pluggable linter for JavaScript that reports and fixes problems in source code through configurable rules and plugins.

  • Eta

    Embedded JavaScript template engine written in TypeScript that renders templates in Node, Deno and the browser.

  • Exceptionless

    Error and log reporting service with a self-hostable server, a web dashboard and client libraries for .NET and JavaScript.

  • Expo Router

    File-based router for universal React Native apps that run on Android, iOS and the web, part of the open-source Expo platform.

  • Express

    Minimalist web framework for Node.js for building web applications and APIs.

F

  • fast-check

    Property-based testing framework for JavaScript and TypeScript that generates inputs to check properties of code.

  • FastAPI

    Python web framework for building APIs from standard Python type hints, served by an ASGI server.

  • Fastify

    Node.js web framework for building HTTP APIs and web applications, with a plugin architecture and schema-based validation.

  • Fiber

    Express-inspired web framework for Go, built on Fasthttp.

  • Floating UI

    JavaScript library that positions floating elements such as tooltips, popovers and dropdowns next to their anchors, with React and Vue bindings.

  • FlyEnv

    Native local development environment for Windows, macOS and Linux that runs runtimes, databases and web servers on the host, with local sites, HTTPS and an MCP server for AI coding agents.

  • Formbricks

    Open-source experience management and survey platform, self-hosted or offered as a hosted cloud service.

  • Formik

    An open source form library for React and React Native that holds form values, validation and submission state.

  • Frappe Framework

    Python and JavaScript low-code web framework for building data-driven web applications, with a built-in admin interface, roles and permissions.

  • Frappe Gantt

    JavaScript library that draws configurable, interactive Gantt charts for the web.

  • Fumadocs

    React documentation framework that composes into an existing React framework to build docs sites.

  • fuzzysort

    JavaScript library that fuzzy-matches search text against strings and object properties, with scores and highlighting.

G

  • Gin

    Go web framework with a Martini-like API for building web services, REST APIs and web applications.

  • go-zero

    Go web and RPC framework with code generation from API definitions, built-in resilience components and the goctl command-line tool.

  • Gophenberg

    Plugin-first CMS with a Go backend, a React admin built on the Gutenberg block editor and optional Astro themes, backed by PostgreSQL.

  • GORM

    Go ORM library that maps structs to database tables, with associations, hooks, transactions and auto migrations.

  • Got

    Human-friendly HTTP request library for Node.js with promise and stream APIs, retries, timeouts and RFC 7234 caching.

  • Gradio

    Python package for building web interfaces and demos for machine learning models and Python functions.

  • Grafana

    Open source application for querying, visualizing, alerting on and exploring metrics, logs and traces.

  • Grafana k6

    Load-testing tool with an engine written in Go that runs test scripts written in JavaScript or TypeScript.

  • Grafana Loki

    Horizontally scalable log aggregation system that indexes log labels rather than the text of log lines.

  • GrapesJS

    Open-source web builder framework that adds a visual editor for HTML templates to an application.

  • GraphQL.js

    JavaScript implementation of the GraphQL specification, providing the parser, validator, executor and type system used to build GraphQL servers, clients and tools.

  • GSAP

    JavaScript animation library, with plugins for scroll, SVG, text and UI animation, that runs in the browser.

  • Guzzle

    PHP HTTP client library for sending HTTP requests and integrating with web services.

H

  • h3

    HTTP server framework for JavaScript runtimes, built on the Request, Response and Headers primitives of the web platform.

  • Handlebars

    JavaScript templating engine that compiles Handlebars templates into functions that render HTML, text and other output.

  • Handsontable

    JavaScript data grid that looks and feels like a spreadsheet, with versions for React, Angular and Vue.

  • HashiCorp Vault

    Server for storing, accessing and encrypting secrets, with an HTTP API, a CLI and a web interface, that applications can call for credentials and keys.

  • Hasura GraphQL Engine

    Open-source GraphQL server that generates a GraphQL API over existing databases and other data sources, with a hosted Hasura Cloud edition.

  • Hexclave

    Open-source user infrastructure platform for authentication, teams, payments, email and analytics, with a managed cloud and a self-hostable server.

  • Hey API

    Code generator that turns OpenAPI specifications into TypeScript clients, schemas and other generated code, published as @hey-api/openapi-ts.

  • highlight.js

    JavaScript syntax highlighter with automatic language detection that runs in the browser and on Node.js.

  • hls.js

    JavaScript library that plays HTTP Live Streaming video in browsers through HTML5 video and Media Source Extensions.

  • Hocuspocus

    WebSocket backend for Yjs documents that syncs changes between clients in real time, from the team behind Tiptap.

  • Hologram

    Elixir full-stack web framework whose client-side code runs in the browser as Elixir, compiled to JavaScript.

  • Hono

    Web framework built on Web Standards that runs on any JavaScript runtime.

  • Huginn

    Self-hosted system for building agents that watch the web and incoming events and take automated actions on the user's behalf.

  • Hugo

    Static site generator written in Go that builds websites from Markdown content and Go templates.

  • Hyperswitch

    Open-source payments orchestration platform that routes transactions across payment processors, with a vault, a control center and reconciliation, self-hosted or hosted by Juspay.

I

  • Immer

    JavaScript package that allows code to work with immutable state in a more convenient way.

  • Infisical

    Open-source platform for managing application secrets, certificates and cryptographic keys, with a CLI, SDKs and a self-hostable server alongside Infisical Cloud.

  • Inngest

    Workflow orchestration platform for durable functions with step retries, scheduling and flow control, run by applications through language SDKs and self-hostable as a single server.

  • InsightFlare

    Privacy-friendly web analytics tool that a site owner deploys to their own Cloudflare account and embeds with a small script.

  • Instant

    Open-source backend for web and mobile apps with a client-side, real-time database, auth, permissions, storage and streams.

J

  • Jaeger

    Open-source distributed tracing platform that collects, stores and shows traces from requests that cross services.

  • Jest

    JavaScript testing framework that bundles assertions, mock functions and snapshot testing.

  • Joi

    JavaScript library that describes the shape of data as a schema and validates values against it.

  • jose

    JavaScript module for JSON Object Signing and Encryption that covers JSON Web Tokens, signatures, encryption and keys.

  • jQuery

    JavaScript library that simplifies HTML document traversal and manipulation, event handling, animation and Ajax.

  • jsdom

    Pure-JavaScript implementation of many DOM and HTML web standards for Node.js, used to test and scrape web applications.

K

  • kepler.gl

    React component and web application for visual exploration of large geolocation data sets, built on MapLibre GL and deck.gl.

  • Kestra

    Open-source orchestration platform for data, AI and infrastructure workflows, defined in YAML and run on a server with a web UI.

  • Keycloak

    Open source identity and access management server with OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 support.

  • Knex.js

    SQL query builder for JavaScript that runs on Node.js and builds queries for several SQL databases.

  • Kobalte

    UI toolkit of unstyled, accessible components and primitives for building web apps with SolidJS.

  • Kokonut UI

    Open-source collection of React components built with Tailwind CSS, Motion and shadcn/ui, installed into a project as source code.

  • Kong Gateway

    Open source API gateway, built on NGINX, that routes, secures and transforms traffic to APIs through plugins, with a Kong Konnect SaaS option.

  • Konva

    JavaScript canvas library that draws and manages interactive 2D shapes as a scene graph in the browser.

  • Kratos

    Go framework for building HTTP and gRPC microservices, with application lifecycle, generated transports, middleware and configuration.

  • Ktor

    Kotlin framework for building asynchronous servers and HTTP clients, extended with plugins and engines.

  • Kumo

    Cloudflare's component library of accessible React UI components for building web applications, built on Base UI.

  • Kuzzle

    Open-source backend server with a pre-built API, realtime notifications and data storage for web, mobile and IoT applications.

  • Kysely

    Type-safe SQL query builder for TypeScript whose result types follow the selected columns.

L

  • Langfuse

    Open-source platform for tracing, evaluating and monitoring LLM applications, sent from application code through SDKs and OpenTelemetry.

  • Laravel

    PHP web application framework with routing, an ORM, templating, queues and scheduled jobs.

  • LayerChart

    Svelte component library of composable chart components for building data visualizations.

  • Leaflet

    JavaScript library for mobile-friendly interactive maps that runs in the browser.

  • Leptos

    Rust framework for building reactive web applications, client-side or full-stack with server rendering and server functions.

  • Lerd

    Open-source local PHP development environment for Linux and macOS that runs sites, PHP versions and services as rootless Podman containers.

  • Less

    Backwards-compatible language extension for CSS that compiles Less stylesheets to plain CSS with Node.js or in the browser.

  • Lexical

    Extensible text editor framework for the web, with a framework-agnostic core and React bindings.

  • Lightning CSS

    CSS parser, transformer, bundler and minifier written in Rust, usable from JavaScript, Rust or a standalone CLI.

  • Lightweight Charts

    JavaScript library that draws interactive financial charts on an HTML5 canvas inside a web page.

  • LimeSurvey

    Open-source survey platform for creating surveys that respondents take through a link or an embed on a website.

  • Litekart

    Self-hosted ecommerce platform whose Go backend, GoCommerce, serves the API and an admin panel for a separate SvelteKit storefront.

  • Lodash

    Modular JavaScript utility library with functions for arrays, collections, objects, strings and functions, published as npm packages and browser builds.

  • Lowdefy

    Config-first web framework that builds business apps and internal tools from YAML configuration, served by a Node.js server.

  • Lucide

    Open-source set of scalable vector icons, distributed as packages for vanilla JavaScript and for frameworks.

  • Luxon

    JavaScript library for working with dates and times, with time zones and Intl formatting.

M

  • MapLibre GL JS

    TypeScript library for publishing interactive vector tile maps in a web browser.

  • Markdoc

    Markdown-based syntax and toolchain for building custom documentation sites, with a parser, a transform step and renderers.

  • markdown-it

    JavaScript Markdown parser that follows the CommonMark specification and supports syntax extensions and plugins.

  • Marked

    Markdown parser and compiler written in JavaScript that converts Markdown to HTML in browsers and on Node.js.

  • Marko

    HTML-based language and runtime for building web applications and user interfaces, with the Marko Run application framework.

  • Mastra

    TypeScript framework for building AI agents and applications.

  • Material UI

    React component library that implements Google's Material Design.

  • MDXEditor

    React rich text editor component that lets users author Markdown documents.

  • Mermaid

    JavaScript diagramming and charting tool that renders diagrams from Markdown-inspired text definitions.

  • micromark

    Markdown parser for JavaScript that follows CommonMark and emits concrete tokens with positional information.

  • Micronaut

    JVM application framework for Java, Kotlin and Groovy with compile-time dependency injection, AOP and HTTP servers and clients.

  • Milkdown

    Plugin-driven WYSIWYG markdown editor framework for web applications.

  • Milvus

    Vector database for storing and searching embeddings, run as a Docker or Kubernetes server or as Milvus Lite, a Python library.

  • mise

    Command-line tool that installs a project's dev tools, sets its environment variables and runs its tasks from one mise.toml file.

  • MobX

    JavaScript library that tracks observable state and re-runs the computations and components that depend on it.

  • Mocha

    JavaScript test framework that runs test suites on Node.js and in the browser.

  • Mockery

    PHP mock object framework for creating test doubles with a readable API in unit tests run with PHPUnit, PHPSpec or another testing framework.

  • Mockito

    Java mocking framework that creates test doubles for unit tests, with an API for stubbing calls and verifying interactions.

  • Moment.js

    JavaScript library for parsing, validating, manipulating and formatting dates and times.

  • Monaco Editor

    Browser-based code editor library, generated from the source of the VS Code editor.

  • MongoDB

    Document database server built on the document model, offered as a community edition and as commercial Enterprise editions.

  • Motion

    Open source animation library for JavaScript, with React and Vue packages.

  • Motion for Vue

    Vue animation library published on npm as motion-v, with components for animating Vue elements.

N

  • n8n

    Workflow automation platform for building AI agents and workflows on a visual canvas, self-hosted or in the cloud.

  • Nano Stores

    State manager for JavaScript and TypeScript made of small atomic stores that work with React, Vue, Svelte and other frameworks.

  • NestJS

    Progressive Node.js framework for building efficient, scalable server-side applications with TypeScript.

  • Netty

    Java network application framework for building protocol servers and clients with an asynchronous, event-driven model.

  • next-intl

    Internationalization toolkit for Next.js that provides translated messages, locale-aware formatting and localized routing.

  • Next.js

    React framework for building full-stack web applications, with routing, rendering and data fetching.

  • nginx

    C-based HTTP web server with reverse proxy, content cache, load balancer and mail proxy features.

  • Nginx Proxy Manager

    Web admin interface for managing Nginx reverse proxy hosts, distributed as a Docker image with free Let's Encrypt certificates.

  • Nift

    Dependency-aware command-line build tool and template language that generates websites from HTML, content and data files.

  • Nitro

    TypeScript server toolkit for full-stack servers with filesystem routing, storage, caching and a Vite plugin, deployable to Node.js, Bun, Deno and serverless hosts.

  • Nock

    HTTP mocking and expectations library for Node.js that intercepts outgoing requests in tests.

  • NocoDB

    Spreadsheet-style interface for building online databases on SQLite, PostgreSQL or an existing database, self-hosted with Docker or offered as NocoDB Cloud.

  • Nodemailer

    Library that sends email from Node.js over SMTP, Amazon SES, sendmail and other transports.

  • Novu

    Open-source notification infrastructure with one API for sending messages across in-app inbox, email, SMS, push and chat channels, self-hostable or available as a cloud service.

  • ntfy

    Self-hostable HTTP publish-subscribe server that delivers published messages as push notifications to phones, desktops and browsers.

  • nuqs

    Type-safe state manager for React that keeps state in the URL query string.

  • Nuxt

    Vue-based framework for building server-rendered, static and hybrid websites and web apps.

  • Nuxt UI

    Vue component library built on Reka UI and Tailwind CSS, used as a Nuxt module or as a Vite plugin in plain Vue apps.

  • nvm

    POSIX shell script that installs and switches between multiple Node.js versions for one user.

O

  • OAuth2 Proxy

    Go reverse proxy that adds OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect authentication in front of web applications.

  • Objection.js

    SQL-friendly ORM for Node.js that works as a relational query builder on top of knex.

  • Observable Plot

    JavaScript library that draws charts from tabular data, built for exploratory data analysis.

  • Odoo

    Suite of web-based open source business apps, including a website builder and an e-commerce app.

  • ofetch

    JavaScript library that wraps the fetch API with JSON parsing, retries, timeouts and interceptors.

  • Open Web Analytics

    Open source web analytics framework that records visits to websites and applications and reports on them, with a JavaScript tracker and a PHP server.

  • openapi-typescript

    Command-line tool and library that generates TypeScript types from OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 schemas.

  • OpenCart

    Open source ecommerce platform written in PHP for running an online store on a web server.

  • openid-client

    OAuth 2 and OpenID Connect client library for JavaScript runtimes such as Node.js, Deno and Cloudflare Workers.

  • Orama

    Search library for full-text, vector and hybrid search that runs in the browser, on a server or at the edge.

  • oRPC

    TypeScript framework for building end-to-end typesafe APIs, served over an RPC protocol and as REST endpoints with an OpenAPI document.

  • Orval

    Generator that produces TypeScript API clients, models and optional mocks from OpenAPI v3 and Swagger v2 specifications.

P

  • Pagefind

    Static search library that builds a search index from built HTML at build time and serves search from static files.

  • Pandoc

    Haskell library and command-line tool that converts documents between markup formats.

  • Paper.js

    JavaScript library for drawing and scripting vector graphics on the HTML5 canvas, in the browser and on Node.js.

  • Paraglide JS

    Compiler-based i18n library that turns translation messages into typed, tree-shakable ESM functions for JavaScript and TypeScript apps.

  • PDF.js

    JavaScript PDF viewer and parser built with HTML5, published as the pdfjs-dist package for use in web applications.

  • PDFKit

    JavaScript library that generates multi-page PDF documents for Node and the browser.

  • PGlite

    Embeddable WebAssembly build of PostgreSQL, packaged as a TypeScript and JavaScript library for the browser, Node.js, Bun and Deno.

  • Phalcon

    Full-stack PHP web framework delivered as a PHP extension.

  • Phosphor Icons

    Open-source icon family of SVG icons in six weights, with packages for the web, React, Vue and other frameworks.

  • PHP-FPM

    FastCGI process manager for PHP, built as an optional SAPI in the PHP source tree.

  • PHPUnit

    Unit testing framework for PHP, installed with Composer and run from the command line.

  • PixiJS

    2D rendering library for the web that draws sprites, text, graphics and filters with WebGL or WebGPU.

  • Plate

    React framework for building rich-text editors, with a headless editor runtime, composable plugins and optional Plate UI components.

  • PlayCanvas Engine

    Open-source web graphics engine for 2D and 3D apps, games and visualizations, built on WebGPU and WebGL2.

  • Playwright

    Browser automation and end-to-end test framework that drives Chromium, Firefox and WebKit through one API.

  • Plotly.py

    Interactive, open-source Python graphing library whose charts can be saved as standalone HTML files.

  • PocketBase

    Open-source Go backend shipped as a single executable, with an embedded SQLite database, realtime subscriptions, authentication and a dashboard.

  • PostCSS

    Tool for transforming CSS with JavaScript plugins.

  • PostHog

    Product analytics platform with session replay, feature flags, experiments, error tracking and surveys, self-hosted from its code or run as PostHog Cloud.

  • Pothos

    GraphQL schema builder for TypeScript that defines schemas in code and extends through a plugin system.

  • Pragmatic drag and drop

    Low-level drag and drop library that can be used with any view library and any design system.

  • Preact

    JavaScript library for building component-based user interfaces on a virtual DOM, with a React-compatible API through an optional alias.

content_html_zh:
A directory of software to build websites and web apps.

  • acme.shACME protocol client written in POSIX shell that issues, installs and renews TLS certificates from ACME certificate authorities.
  • Active RecordObject-relational mapping library for Ruby that maps classes to database tables, distributed as part of Rails.
  • ActivepiecesWorkflow automation platform with a self-hostable server and an embeddable builder that a SaaS product can place inside its own app.
  • AdminerWeb-based database management tool distributed as a single PHP file.
  • aiohttpAsynchronous HTTP client and server library for Python, built on asyncio, with a web server and a client session API.
  • AjvJSON Schema and JSON Type Definition validator for Node.js and browsers that compiles schemas into validation functions.
  • AlineaGit-based headless CMS for Next.js that stores every entry as a JSON file in the project repository.
  • AngularTypeScript-based web application framework with client-side, server-side and prerendered rendering.
  • Ant DesignEnterprise-class UI design language and React component library.
  • Apache APISIXOpen-source API gateway for routing, securing and managing traffic to APIs, microservices and LLM providers, built on NGINX and etcd.
  • Apache EChartsJavaScript library for interactive charts and data visualization that runs in the browser.
  • Apache OFBizJava suite of enterprise business applications for ERP, CRM and e-commerce, built on an entity engine, a service engine and a widget-based UI.
  • Apache ShenYuJava-native API gateway for HTTP, Dubbo, gRPC and WebSocket services, with plugins for authentication, traffic control and observability.
  • Apache SkyWalkingApplication performance monitoring system for distributed systems, microservices and container-based architectures.
  • Apache TomcatJava servlet and JSP container, an open source implementation of the Jakarta Servlet, Pages, Expression Language, WebSocket, Annotations and Authentication specifications.
  • ApexChartsJavaScript charting library that draws interactive charts with SVG for websites and web apps.
  • Apollo ClientGraphQL client library for JavaScript that fetches, caches and modifies remote and local application data.
  • AppsmithOpen source low-code platform for building internal tools, admin panels and dashboards.
  • AppwriteOpen-source backend platform with authentication, databases, storage, functions and messaging, available as Appwrite Cloud or self-hosted with Docker.
  • ArangoDBMulti-model database for documents, graphs and key-value data, queried with the AQL query language.
  • AriakitOpen-source React library of unstyled, accessible UI primitives and components for building web apps and design systems.
  • asdfCommand-line version manager for language runtimes and developer tools, configured per project in a .tool-versions file.
  • ASP.NET CoreCross-platform, open-source framework for building web apps and services with .NET and C#.
  • assistant-uiOpen-source TypeScript and React library of components for building AI chat interfaces.
  • AstroWeb framework for content-driven websites that prerenders pages to static HTML and can render routes on demand.
  • AstryxOpen source React design system built on StyleX, with themes and a command-line tool.
  • Atomic ServerSelf-hostable server for storage, search, sharing and sync of Atomic Data, with a web app and a RESTful API.
  • AutheliaOpen-source authentication and authorization server and portal that adds multi-factor authentication and single sign-on in front of web applications.
  • authentikSelf-hosted, open source identity provider with OIDC, SAML, LDAP and proxy authentication.
  • AutoAnimateZero-config, drop-in animation utility that adds transitions to a web app when elements are added, removed or moved.
  • AutoprefixerPostCSS plugin that parses CSS and adds vendor prefixes to rules, using browser support data from Can I Use.
  • AxiosPromise-based HTTP client for the browser and Node.js.

B

  • BabelJavaScript compiler that rewrites next-generation JavaScript into code that runs in the browsers and runtimes a project targets.
  • Base UIUnstyled React component library for building accessible user interfaces.
  • Better AuthFramework-agnostic authentication and authorization framework for TypeScript.
  • BiomeToolchain for web projects with a formatter and a linter, usable from the command line and through a language server.
  • Bits UIHeadless, unstyled Svelte component primitives for building accessible component libraries.
  • BlazorWeb UI framework for building interactive web apps with C# and Razor components, shipped as part of ASP.NET Core.
  • BlockNoteBlock-based rich text editor for React applications.
  • BokehPython library for interactive plots and data applications that render in web browsers.
  • BootstrapHTML, CSS and JavaScript toolkit for developing responsive, mobile-first projects on the web.
  • BunFast all-in-one JavaScript and TypeScript runtime that also ships a package manager, test runner and bundler as one executable.

C

  • c15tOpen-source consent manager that renders cookie banners, a preferences dialog and consent-gated scripts for JavaScript frameworks.
  • Camaleon CMSContent management system for Ruby on Rails, distributed as a gem and run inside a Rails application.
  • Carbon Components SvelteSvelte component library implementing IBM's open source Carbon Design System.
  • cert-managerKubernetes controller that issues and renews X.509 TLS certificates for workloads in a Kubernetes or OpenShift cluster.
  • ChaiAssertion library for Node.js and the browser that pairs with any JavaScript test framework.
  • Chart.jsJavaScript charting library that draws charts on an HTML5 canvas.
  • ChartistJavaScript library that draws responsive charts as SVG, styled with CSS.
  • ClickHouseColumn-oriented SQL database management system for analytical queries, available as open-source server software and as a cloud service.
  • CockroachDBDistributed SQL database that runs as a cluster of nodes and keeps its data replicated across them.
  • CompanionOpen source Node.js server that handles OAuth and streams files from remote sources such as Google Drive and Dropbox into uploads made with Uppy.
  • CompiledCompile-time CSS-in-JS library for React that writes its styles out as atomic CSS.
  • Connect for ECMAScriptTypeScript implementation of Connect, a family of libraries for building type-safe APIs from Protocol Buffers schemas.
  • ConvexOpen-source reactive database and backend for web apps, with server functions written in TypeScript and a cloud platform run by the maker.
  • CookieConsentVanilla JavaScript consent management library that shows a cookie banner and blocks scripts until visitors consent.
  • CoolifyOpen-source, self-hostable platform that deploys applications, databases and services to Docker containers on the user's own servers.
  • Countly LiteSelf-hosted analytics and engagement server that collects data from web, mobile and desktop applications and shows it in dashboards.
  • cssnanoModular CSS minifier, built on the PostCSS ecosystem, that compresses stylesheets with a set of optimizations and presets.
  • cvaA TypeScript library for building type-safe, variant-driven class names with Tailwind CSS or any other styling approach.
  • CypressEnd-to-end and component testing framework that runs tests in a real browser.

D

  • D3JavaScript library for bespoke data visualization that runs in the browser.
  • date-fnsJavaScript library of functions for manipulating dates in browsers and on Node.js.
  • Day.jsJavaScript library that parses, validates, manipulates and displays dates and times, with a largely Moment.js-compatible API.
  • DBeaverDesktop database management tool and SQL client for many SQL and NoSQL databases, with a free community edition.
  • DeviseAuthentication solution for Rails based on Warden, with modules for sign-in, registration, confirmation, password recovery and account locking.
  • DieselSafe, extensible ORM and query builder for Rust.
  • DioxusRust framework for building fullstack web, desktop and mobile apps from one codebase.
  • DjangoPython web framework with an ORM, URL routing, templating, forms and an automatic admin interface.
  • Django REST frameworkToolkit for building Web APIs on Django, with serialization, views, authentication and permissions.
  • dnd kitDrag and drop toolkit for the web, with a framework-agnostic core and adapters for React, Vue, Svelte and Solid.
  • Doctrine DBALPHP database abstraction layer with an object-oriented API for queries and for schema introspection and management.
  • Doctrine ORMPHP object-relational mapper that provides transparent persistence for PHP objects.
  • DokkuSelf-hosted platform as a service that runs on a single Linux server and deploys web apps pushed to it with git.
  • DOMPurifyDOM-based XSS sanitizer that cleans HTML, MathML and SVG markup in the browser or on Node.js.
  • dotCMSJava content management system with an admin console, REST and GraphQL APIs and multi-site management, distributed as a Docker image and as a managed cloud service.
  • Driver.jsJavaScript library for product tours, element highlights and feature hints on web pages.
  • Drizzle ORMTypeScript ORM that maps SQL databases to typed schemas and queries, with a companion migration tool, Drizzle Kit.
  • DuckDBAnalytical SQL database that runs in-process inside Python, Node.js and other applications, with a WebAssembly build for browsers.

E

  • e107Open-source PHP content management system for websites, blogs and intranets, with a plugin and theme system.
  • Easy CMSEmbedded headless CMS that runs inside a Nuxt or Next.js app, with a typed local API, a REST API and an admin at /admin.
  • EchoGo web framework built on the standard net/http package, with a radix-tree router, request binding, middleware and centralized error handling.
  • EffectTypeScript library for building production-grade applications, with typed errors, dependency injection, concurrency, scheduling and schema validation.
  • ElysiaTypeScript web framework for building backend servers, optimized for Bun and also runnable on Node.js.
  • Embla CarouselJavaScript carousel library with fluid motion, swipe gestures and a plugin system, usable with React, Vue, Svelte, Solid or plain JavaScript.
  • EmDashFull-stack TypeScript CMS built on Astro, with an admin panel, a REST API and a plugin system, that runs on Cloudflare or a Node.js server.
  • EmotionCSS-in-JS library for writing styles with JavaScript, with packages for React and for other frameworks.
  • EnvoyOpen source edge and service proxy for cloud-native applications.
  • es-toolkitJavaScript utility library of general-purpose functions for arrays, objects, promises and types, with a compatibility layer for Lodash.
  • esbuildJavaScript and TypeScript bundler and minifier, shipped as a native binary with a JavaScript API.
  • ESLintPluggable linter for JavaScript that reports and fixes problems in source code through configurable rules and plugins.
  • EtaEmbedded JavaScript template engine written in TypeScript that renders templates in Node, Deno and the browser.
  • ExceptionlessError and log reporting service with a self-hostable server, a web dashboard and client libraries for .NET and JavaScript.
  • Expo RouterFile-based router for universal React Native apps that run on Android, iOS and the web, part of the open-source Expo platform.
  • ExpressMinimalist web framework for Node.js for building web applications and APIs.

F

  • fast-checkProperty-based testing framework for JavaScript and TypeScript that generates inputs to check properties of code.
  • FastAPIPython web framework for building APIs from standard Python type hints, served by an ASGI server.
  • FastifyNode.js web framework for building HTTP APIs and web applications, with a plugin architecture and schema-based validation.
  • FiberExpress-inspired web framework for Go, built on Fasthttp.
  • Floating UIJavaScript library that positions floating elements such as tooltips, popovers and dropdowns next to their anchors, with React and Vue bindings.
  • FlyEnvNative local development environment for Windows, macOS and Linux that runs runtimes, databases and web servers on the host, with local sites, HTTPS and an MCP server for AI coding agents.
  • FormbricksOpen-source experience management and survey platform, self-hosted or offered as a hosted cloud service.
  • FormikAn open source form library for React and React Native that holds form values, validation and submission state.
  • Frappe FrameworkPython and JavaScript low-code web framework for building data-driven web applications, with a built-in admin interface, roles and permissions.
  • Frappe GanttJavaScript library that draws configurable, interactive Gantt charts for the web.
  • FumadocsReact documentation framework that composes into an existing React framework to build docs sites.
  • fuzzysortJavaScript library that fuzzy-matches search text against strings and object properties, with scores and highlighting.

G

  • GinGo web framework with a Martini-like API for building web services, REST APIs and web applications.
  • go-zeroGo web and RPC framework with code generation from API definitions, built-in resilience components and the goctl command-line tool.
  • GophenbergPlugin-first CMS with a Go backend, a React admin built on the Gutenberg block editor and optional Astro themes, backed by PostgreSQL.
  • GORMGo ORM library that maps structs to database tables, with associations, hooks, transactions and auto migrations.
  • GotHuman-friendly HTTP request library for Node.js with promise and stream APIs, retries, timeouts and RFC 7234 caching.
  • GradioPython package for building web interfaces and demos for machine learning models and Python functions.
  • GrafanaOpen source application for querying, visualizing, alerting on and exploring metrics, logs and traces.
  • Grafana k6Load-testing tool with an engine written in Go that runs test scripts written in JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Grafana LokiHorizontally scalable log aggregation system that indexes log labels rather than the text of log lines.
  • GrapesJSOpen-source web builder framework that adds a visual editor for HTML templates to an application.
  • GraphQL.jsJavaScript implementation of the GraphQL specification, providing the parser, validator, executor and type system used to build GraphQL servers, clients and tools.
  • GSAPJavaScript animation library, with plugins for scroll, SVG, text and UI animation, that runs in the browser.
  • GuzzlePHP HTTP client library for sending HTTP requests and integrating with web services.

H

  • h3HTTP server framework for JavaScript runtimes, built on the Request, Response and Headers primitives of the web platform.
  • HandlebarsJavaScript templating engine that compiles Handlebars templates into functions that render HTML, text and other output.
  • HandsontableJavaScript data grid that looks and feels like a spreadsheet, with versions for React, Angular and Vue.
  • HashiCorp VaultServer for storing, accessing and encrypting secrets, with an HTTP API, a CLI and a web interface, that applications can call for credentials and keys.
  • Hasura GraphQL EngineOpen-source GraphQL server that generates a GraphQL API over existing databases and other data sources, with a hosted Hasura Cloud edition.
  • HexclaveOpen-source user infrastructure platform for authentication, teams, payments, email and analytics, with a managed cloud and a self-hostable server.
  • Hey APICode generator that turns OpenAPI specifications into TypeScript clients, schemas and other generated code, published as @hey-api/openapi-ts.
  • highlight.jsJavaScript syntax highlighter with automatic language detection that runs in the browser and on Node.js.
  • hls.jsJavaScript library that plays HTTP Live Streaming video in browsers through HTML5 video and Media Source Extensions.
  • HocuspocusWebSocket backend for Yjs documents that syncs changes between clients in real time, from the team behind Tiptap.
  • HologramElixir full-stack web framework whose client-side code runs in the browser as Elixir, compiled to JavaScript.
  • HonoWeb framework built on Web Standards that runs on any JavaScript runtime.
  • HuginnSelf-hosted system for building agents that watch the web and incoming events and take automated actions on the user's behalf.
  • HugoStatic site generator written in Go that builds websites from Markdown content and Go templates.
  • HyperswitchOpen-source payments orchestration platform that routes transactions across payment processors, with a vault, a control center and reconciliation, self-hosted or hosted by Juspay.

I

  • ImmerJavaScript package that allows code to work with immutable state in a more convenient way.
  • InfisicalOpen-source platform for managing application secrets, certificates and cryptographic keys, with a CLI, SDKs and a self-hostable server alongside Infisical Cloud.
  • InngestWorkflow orchestration platform for durable functions with step retries, scheduling and flow control, run by applications through language SDKs and self-hostable as a single server.
  • InsightFlarePrivacy-friendly web analytics tool that a site owner deploys to their own Cloudflare account and embeds with a small script.
  • InstantOpen-source backend for web and mobile apps with a client-side, real-time database, auth, permissions, storage and streams.

J

  • JaegerOpen-source distributed tracing platform that collects, stores and shows traces from requests that cross services.
  • JestJavaScript testing framework that bundles assertions, mock functions and snapshot testing.
  • JoiJavaScript library that describes the shape of data as a schema and validates values against it.
  • joseJavaScript module for JSON Object Signing and Encryption that covers JSON Web Tokens, signatures, encryption and keys.
  • jQueryJavaScript library that simplifies HTML document traversal and manipulation, event handling, animation and Ajax.
  • jsdomPure-JavaScript implementation of many DOM and HTML web standards for Node.js, used to test and scrape web applications.

K

  • kepler.glReact component and web application for visual exploration of large geolocation data sets, built on MapLibre GL and deck.gl.
  • KestraOpen-source orchestration platform for data, AI and infrastructure workflows, defined in YAML and run on a server with a web UI.
  • KeycloakOpen source identity and access management server with OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 support.
  • Knex.jsSQL query builder for JavaScript that runs on Node.js and builds queries for several SQL databases.
  • KobalteUI toolkit of unstyled, accessible components and primitives for building web apps with SolidJS.
  • Kokonut UIOpen-source collection of React components built with Tailwind CSS, Motion and shadcn/ui, installed into a project as source code.
  • Kong GatewayOpen source API gateway, built on NGINX, that routes, secures and transforms traffic to APIs through plugins, with a Kong Konnect SaaS option.
  • KonvaJavaScript canvas library that draws and manages interactive 2D shapes as a scene graph in the browser.
  • KratosGo framework for building HTTP and gRPC microservices, with application lifecycle, generated transports, middleware and configuration.
  • KtorKotlin framework for building asynchronous servers and HTTP clients, extended with plugins and engines.
  • KumoCloudflare's component library of accessible React UI components for building web applications, built on Base UI.
  • KuzzleOpen-source backend server with a pre-built API, realtime notifications and data storage for web, mobile and IoT applications.
  • KyselyType-safe SQL query builder for TypeScript whose result types follow the selected columns.

L

  • LangfuseOpen-source platform for tracing, evaluating and monitoring LLM applications, sent from application code through SDKs and OpenTelemetry.
  • LaravelPHP web application framework with routing, an ORM, templating, queues and scheduled jobs.
  • LayerChartSvelte component library of composable chart components for building data visualizations.
  • LeafletJavaScript library for mobile-friendly interactive maps that runs in the browser.
  • LeptosRust framework for building reactive web applications, client-side or full-stack with server rendering and server functions.
  • LerdOpen-source local PHP development environment for Linux and macOS that runs sites, PHP versions and services as rootless Podman containers.
  • LessBackwards-compatible language extension for CSS that compiles Less stylesheets to plain CSS with Node.js or in the browser.
  • LexicalExtensible text editor framework for the web, with a framework-agnostic core and React bindings.
  • Lightning CSSCSS parser, transformer, bundler and minifier written in Rust, usable from JavaScript, Rust or a standalone CLI.
  • Lightweight ChartsJavaScript library that draws interactive financial charts on an HTML5 canvas inside a web page.
  • LimeSurveyOpen-source survey platform for creating surveys that respondents take through a link or an embed on a website.
  • LitekartSelf-hosted ecommerce platform whose Go backend, GoCommerce, serves the API and an admin panel for a separate SvelteKit storefront.
  • LodashModular JavaScript utility library with functions for arrays, collections, objects, strings and functions, published as npm packages and browser builds.
  • LowdefyConfig-first web framework that builds business apps and internal tools from YAML configuration, served by a Node.js server.
  • LucideOpen-source set of scalable vector icons, distributed as packages for vanilla JavaScript and for frameworks.
  • LuxonJavaScript library for working with dates and times, with time zones and Intl formatting.

M

  • MapLibre GL JSTypeScript library for publishing interactive vector tile maps in a web browser.
  • MarkdocMarkdown-based syntax and toolchain for building custom documentation sites, with a parser, a transform step and renderers.
  • markdown-itJavaScript Markdown parser that follows the CommonMark specification and supports syntax extensions and plugins.
  • MarkedMarkdown parser and compiler written in JavaScript that converts Markdown to HTML in browsers and on Node.js.
  • MarkoHTML-based language and runtime for building web applications and user interfaces, with the Marko Run application framework.
  • MastraTypeScript framework for building AI agents and applications.
  • Material UIReact component library that implements Google's Material Design.
  • MDXEditorReact rich text editor component that lets users author Markdown documents.
  • MermaidJavaScript diagramming and charting tool that renders diagrams from Markdown-inspired text definitions.
  • micromarkMarkdown parser for JavaScript that follows CommonMark and emits concrete tokens with positional information.
  • MicronautJVM application framework for Java, Kotlin and Groovy with compile-time dependency injection, AOP and HTTP servers and clients.
  • MilkdownPlugin-driven WYSIWYG markdown editor framework for web applications.
  • MilvusVector database for storing and searching embeddings, run as a Docker or Kubernetes server or as Milvus Lite, a Python library.
  • miseCommand-line tool that installs a project's dev tools, sets its environment variables and runs its tasks from one mise.toml file.
  • MobXJavaScript library that tracks observable state and re-runs the computations and components that depend on it.
  • MochaJavaScript test framework that runs test suites on Node.js and in the browser.
  • MockeryPHP mock object framework for creating test doubles with a readable API in unit tests run with PHPUnit, PHPSpec or another testing framework.
  • MockitoJava mocking framework that creates test doubles for unit tests, with an API for stubbing calls and verifying interactions.
  • Moment.jsJavaScript library for parsing, validating, manipulating and formatting dates and times.
  • Monaco EditorBrowser-based code editor library, generated from the source of the VS Code editor.
  • MongoDBDocument database server built on the document model, offered as a community edition and as commercial Enterprise editions.
  • MotionOpen source animation library for JavaScript, with React and Vue packages.
  • Motion for VueVue animation library published on npm as motion-v, with components for animating Vue elements.

N

  • n8nWorkflow automation platform for building AI agents and workflows on a visual canvas, self-hosted or in the cloud.
  • Nano StoresState manager for JavaScript and TypeScript made of small atomic stores that work with React, Vue, Svelte and other frameworks.
  • NestJSProgressive Node.js framework for building efficient, scalable server-side applications with TypeScript.
  • NettyJava network application framework for building protocol servers and clients with an asynchronous, event-driven model.
  • next-intlInternationalization toolkit for Next.js that provides translated messages, locale-aware formatting and localized routing.
  • Next.jsReact framework for building full-stack web applications, with routing, rendering and data fetching.
  • nginxC-based HTTP web server with reverse proxy, content cache, load balancer and mail proxy features.
  • Nginx Proxy ManagerWeb admin interface for managing Nginx reverse proxy hosts, distributed as a Docker image with free Let's Encrypt certificates.
  • NiftDependency-aware command-line build tool and template language that generates websites from HTML, content and data files.
  • NitroTypeScript server toolkit for full-stack servers with filesystem routing, storage, caching and a Vite plugin, deployable to Node.js, Bun, Deno and serverless hosts.
  • NockHTTP mocking and expectations library for Node.js that intercepts outgoing requests in tests.
  • NocoDBSpreadsheet-style interface for building online databases on SQLite, PostgreSQL or an existing database, self-hosted with Docker or offered as NocoDB Cloud.
  • NodemailerLibrary that sends email from Node.js over SMTP, Amazon SES, sendmail and other transports.
  • NovuOpen-source notification infrastructure with one API for sending messages across in-app inbox, email, SMS, push and chat channels, self-hostable or available as a cloud service.
  • ntfySelf-hostable HTTP publish-subscribe server that delivers published messages as push notifications to phones, desktops and browsers.
